scope: Geographic coordinates and identifying facts only. No photographs, captions, geological prose, textbook vector paths, or textbook layouts are included.

datasets.rights_basis: Natural Earth publishes its raster and vector map data in the public domain.
datasets.usage: Continent coast geometry and world-map land background; independently projected and styled.

datasets.rights_basis: USGS-produced data are in the U.S. public domain; no third-party photographs or illustrations used.
datasets.usage: Major tectonic plate boundary coordinates, drawn in an independent world map.

datasets.rights_basis: GVP terms identify the database compilation as work of U.S. government employees in the public domain. Only volcano IDs and point coordinates are redistributed; photos and descriptive prose are excluded.
datasets.citation: Global Volcanism Program, 2026. Volcanoes of the World (v. 5.4.0; 7 Aug 2026), Smithsonian Institution, compiled by Venzke, E. https://doi.org/10.5479/si.GVP.VOTW5-2026.5.4
datasets.usage: Locations of 1,214 Holocene volcanoes; not a map of volcanoes currently erupting.
